title: Walking tour near our hotel
text: Mateo did a great job taking us on a walking tour of the area near our hotel. Visited parks and different scenic locations. We enjoyed 😉
author: Polly_T

title: Enthusiastic and Educational
text: Jordi did a wonderful job showing us historical and architectural points of interest.  He added to the tour by pointing out lesser known and even mysterious aspects of old Barcelona. Jordi was enthusiastic and friendly - thank you! ⭐️
author: Tina E

title: Tour with Mateos
text: We had an incredible tour with Mateos and his company. We learned so much and truly enjoyed our time with Mateos. This tour was the highlight of our holiday in Barcelona. I highly recommend Mateos and will definitely use his services again.
author: panagiotisg948

title: Touring Barcelona
text: Mateos was amazing and very knowledgeable. He made a great impression on us and made fall in love with Barcelona… we strongly recommend Mateos and his company for anyone looking to learn more about Barcelona…
author: E6332BOpeterg

title: Great tour with Marco
text: Marco took us through Sagrada Familia and Casa Batllo and the exterior of Casa Mila. It was a great day. We learned so much about Gaudí and the architects  and the history behind everything. He was awesome! We highly recommend him!
author: kfrieman1

title: Highly Recommended Experience
text:
Great one!!
The guide perfectly followed our itinerary and shared incredible facts of each place we visited, it was fantastic. We crafted our own journey and discovered Barcelona in just a day, visiting the most interesting places such as Sagrada Familia and Casa Batlló.
author: Andrea_C

title: 10/10 Experience
text: Such an incredible experience! I didn't know Barcelona before, and it was the best way to discover the city. I could decide myself what to visit, but the guide also provided me with really interesting facts that I didn't expect. Totally recommend this to everyone!!!
author: Roger_C

title: Incredible tour!!
text: That was the first time I had the opportunity to customize myself the way of exploring a city, and it was AMAZING. I discovered the best monuments and famous places of Barcelona but the guide also provided me with really interesting facts of the city. I would totally recommend it, and more if you are a group of people aiming to discover the city all together!!
author: Carla_F
